sn_aia_version.instructions: Review environmental pollution and compliance records. Identify abnormal pollution levels, high-risk incidents, or regulatory concerns. Check pending inspections, approvals, and compliance actions against their due dates and SLA requirements. Detect delayed or overdue approvals and determine the severity of the delay. Identify the responsible authority and determine whether escalation is required. Initiate the appropriate escalation and notification for delayed or high-risk compliance issues. Record the monitoring result, escalation reason, and recommended next action.
